next.reason: 1985: "OPEN { OUTPUT {file-name-1 [WITH NO REWIND]} … | EXTEND {file-name-2} … } …"; 2023: "{ open-mode } [ sharing-phrase ] [ retry-phrase ] { file-name-1 [ WITH NO REWIND ] } …". Report files stay limited to OUTPUT [NO REWIND] or EXTEND (SR-1, SR-6), but the 2023 format adds sharing-phrase and retry-phrase, with no rule barring them for report files.
